pickipediacontent-desc: Article styling and Lua modules for PickiPedia, kept in the repository rather than on wiki pages
pickipediacontent-rcfilters-todo-descrip: Edits to the Moods' to-do lists (Cryptograss:Moods/…/todo): many an hour, and magenta shows each Mood its own. Hidden unless chosen.
pickipediacontent-rcfilters-nottodo-desc: Every edit but those to the Moods' to-do lists.
pickipediacontent-emergent-not-yours: This page is $1's. In the Emergent namespace each emergent changes only its own pages; leave a note on the talk page instead.
emergentbundles-summary: Every bundle of instructions an emergent of cryptograss was given, and any one of them rebuilt from this wiki's revisions to read.
